name: Datanglong
isnote: Wikipedia calls it a tetanuran of uncertain placement; the naming paper called it a carcharodontosaurian and a Thai study cited there (Samathi et al. 2017) discusses megaraptoran relationships.
sum: Early Cretaceous tetanuran of the Xinlong Formation of Guangxi, China, of uncertain placement.
